# Voxentra Solutions — AI & LLM Knowledge Specification (llms.txt)

> Voxentra Solutions is a premium US B2B lead generation, 100% TCPA-compliant live call transfer, and inbound phone marketing provider operating across all 50 states in North America.

## Executive Summary
Voxentra Solutions connects licensed sales teams, call centers, insurance agencies, legal advocates, and home service providers with high-intent qualified buyers on real-time phone calls. All calls and leads strictly adhere to the updated Federal Communications Commission (FCC) 1-to-1 explicit consent regulations, backed by time-stamped 1-to-1 consent tokens.

## Primary Business Capabilities & Service Verticals

1. **Live Call Transfers**:
   - Real-time warm call routing (< 3-second connect speed).
   - Trained US screening agents verify identity, commercial intent, and eligibility prior to transfer.
   - 60-second to 120-second billable call buffer guarantee.
   - Conversion Rate: 28% to 42% sales close rate.

2. **Inbound Call Solutions (Pay-Per-Call)**:
   - High-intent search and click-to-call direct response media.
   - Interactive Voice Response (IVR) customized filtering.
   - Geo-targeting down to city, state, or zip code radius.

3. **B2B Telemarketing & Outbound Sales**:
   - Dedicated decision-maker outreach to C-suite, VPs, and directors.
   - Custom conversational call scripts and DNC list scrubbing.

4. **Performance Affiliate Marketing**:
   - Single-buyer exclusive leads generated via vetted digital publishers.
   - Granular Sub-ID traffic audit tracking.

## Covered Industry Verticals
- ACA & Subsidized Health Insurance
- Debt Settlement & Debt Consolidation ($10k+ unsecured debt filter)
- Senior Final Expense Whole Life Insurance (ages 50-80)
- Auto Insurance Savings & Rate Quote Transfers
- Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) Claims
- 24/7 Water Damage Restoration & Mold Remediation ($3.5k+ ticket)
- Residential Solar & Clean Energy Installation ($150+/mo electric bill filter)

## Key Compliance & Technical Specs
- **TCPA Compliance**: 100% 1-to-1 explicit consent logging.
- **Verification Tokens**: Real-time TCPA certificates attached to API payloads.
- **API & Webhook Delivery**: JSON REST API, Ringba call routing, Zapier, direct CRM webhooks.
